name: trello_board_already_linked
description: A project has ONE board. Once it has one, asking to create a board must not produce a proposal to create a second -- the agent should already know, before asking the user to confirm anything.

turns.message: manda las tareas de Marketing Q3 a Trello
turns.why: No board yet: the agent must ask, and must offer both options.
The board is created in the user's real Trello account, so this turn only proposes.
Creates the board, links the project, and exports -- the goal from turn 1 was to send the tasks.

turns.message: crea un tablero nuevo de Trello para Marketing Q3
turns.why: THE POINT OF THIS CASE. The project now has a board. The agent must say so instead of proposing a second one -- and must not ask the user to confirm something it already knows is wrong.

response_not_matches: (?i)(voy a crear|he creado|confirmas que quieres crear)
assert.comment: A second board must be impossible, AND the wasted confirmation turn must not happen either.

turns.why: Even if turn 4 slipped and proposed, confirming must not produce a second board.

assert.comment: The guard inside create_trello_board is the last line of defence; a board created here is a hard failure.
